segments.tts: One guy scored five goals, five different ways?!
Cute. I've let in goals six different ways. Before lunch.
December thirty-first, 1988. Mario Lemieux scores five goals against the Devils. Even strength, power play, shorthanded, penalty shot, and empty net.
Not every way. Nobody's scored off my face. Yet.
February seventh, 1976. Darryl Sittler gets ten points in one game. Six goals, four assists. Still the NHL record.
Two. Minutes. For tripping over the blue line.
April fifteenth, 1952. Two Detroit fans throw an octopus on the ice. Eight legs, for the eight wins needed to take the Cup.
I'll throw a fish for every goal I score!
Great. The ice stays clean forever.
Finally. A teammate who never leaves the crease.
